title: Landforms and Water | Grade 3 Geography for Kids | Little Takhti
description:
Travel across Pakistan with Takhti to learn landforms: mountains, valleys, plateaus, plains, deserts and islands. Then follow a drop of water from a glacier down the Indus River to the Arabian Sea, and try a quick quiz. For Grade 3 children (ages 8 to 9).

Free printable worksheets, quizzes and games for this topic: https://littletakhti.netlify.app/class-3-geography-landforms-and-water-worksheets/

Chapters
0:00 Hello
0:12 Landforms
0:39 Water bodies
1:02 Quiz
1:45 Remember

Little Takhti makes free learning for children in Pakistan, Nursery to Grade 3. https://littletakhti.netlify.app
